scope: Diagnostic ordered HG operator implemented in Exam/exam.c; not enabled for ordinary MPI time integration
algorithm: Replicate only globally unique mode keys and owning-rank/local-mode index metadata.
Sort by canonical global key. Walk forward and then reverse, applying tau/2 per mode as original hg_apply.
Group maximal consecutive keys owned by one rank; request current vx,vy,ie for the remote support union from actual owners.
Call the existing hg_apply_mode in original order and return modified remote state to owners before the next group.
After both passes, refresh pressure and sound speed on owned particles.
reference: GFS_MPI_HG_APPLY_SERIAL=1 invokes original hg_apply; only valid at one rank.
guards: Requires terminal geometry diagnostic, validated two-hop state, completed mode construction and positive finite tau.
Only ordinary HG kind 0; bulk/b-prime excluded by mode probe.
No RK integration, accepted-state update, particle migration or retry is permitted in this path.
limitations: Synchronous ordered reference prioritizes matching equations; performance/scaling not claimed.
Owner/key maps and ghost states are scoped to one geometry snapshot.
Global RK accept/reject and ownership rollback remain to implement.
No CUDA hydrodynamic-force or HG acceleration coverage.
